gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-lexend-tera: Rigid, ruler-straight monospace up top, with Major Mono Display's strokes never swelling or thinning anywhere; Lexend Tera spaces its open, plotter-pen curves far apart below. They keep each other honest.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-lexend-zett: Major Mono Display draws every stroke at zero contrast, with terminals pulled back from each curve. Lexend Zetta, a plain sans, spreads tall-bodied letters across wide tracking, easygoing where the heading is exacting.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-montserrat-: Montserrat Alternates reads wide and friendly, its lowercase crowding up toward the capital line in a chalk-board way. Major Mono Display sits above it, precise and uniform, giving that softness a ruled frame to hang from.
gen-gf-mali-fs-bespoke-serif: Loose, pen-scrawled charm on top, then a sturdy text serif whose thin strokes run about half the weight of its thick ones. Shrink Mali and its casual looseness would fade, while Bespoke Serif stays dignified.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code takes the body, a sans with wire-thin monoline strokes and neighbors held well apart. Shrink Manuale down and its robust downstrokes and slender turns lose their bookish flavor, while the code face keeps its constant line.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-julius-sans-one: Literary and a touch old-fashioned, Manuale's thick-thin shifts stay soft, never dropping to razor hairlines. And Julius Sans One, traced as if with one marker, lets a long passage drift along with open curves and wide gaps between letters.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-lexend-exa: Soft-pencil serif above, wide plain sans below, with Lexend Exa's big x-height and stubby ascenders. Make Manuale small and its medium contrast softens.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-lexend-giga: Lowercase that nearly matches its capitals gives Manuale a bookish steadiness. Lexend Giga then runs flat, single-weight lines with generous tracking, so a long passage moves along in a smooth, unhurried rhythm.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-lexend-mega: Manuale's stems run just slightly thicker than its connecting strokes. Blow Lexend Mega up large and its one-nib uniformity shows, every ending at the same thickness, while a small Manuale would lose that pencil softness.
gen-gf-manuale-gf-lexend-peta: Manuale has a mellow thick-thin shift, like a soft pencil, and lowercase close to its capitals. Lexend Peta brings round letters whose rims match the stems, with a big x-height and wide-mouthed c shapes.
